name: grep
description: Search file contents with a ripgrep regular expression. Returns matching paths by default. A path under the working directory is given from it. Escape literal braces.

path.description: File or directory to search. Omit for the working directory.

glob.description: Only search files matching this glob, such as "*.go".

type.description: Only search files of this ripgrep type, such as go, py or rust.

output_mode.description: content returns matching lines, files_with_matches returns paths (the default), count returns matches per file.

-B.description: Lines to show before each match, in content mode.

-A.description: Lines to show after each match, in content mode.

context.description: Lines to show before and after each match, in content mode.

-n.description: Show line numbers in content mode. Defaults to true.

multiline.description: Let a pattern span lines, with . matching a line break.

head_limit.description: Return at most this many lines or entries. Defaults to 250. 0 means no limit.

offset.description: Skip this many lines or entries first.
